atAGlance: Tàu hũ nước đường is soft tofu pudding in ginger sugar syrup. It is silky, warm or chilled, and gentler than many coconut-heavy desserts.
whatItIs: Tàu hũ nước đường is silken tofu pudding served with sweet ginger syrup.
howToEnjoy: Spoon carefully so the tofu stays silky. Ginger syrup gives the dessert its warmth.
howLocalsOrder: Order tàu hũ nước đường warm if available, then spoon gently so the tofu custard stays silky in the ginger syrup.
worthKnowing: Tàu hũ nước đường is a gentle street dessert with Chinese-Vietnamese roots, showing how soft tofu can become dessert when paired with ginger syrup.
goodToKnow: This is dessert tofu, not savory tofu. The texture should be very soft and spoonable.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần tàu hũ nước đường.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of silken tofu with ginger syrup.
